title: ICICI Lombard Lost Money on Insurance. How Did It Profit?

beats.say: Can an insurer lose money on insurance, and still profit? From July to September twenty twenty six, ICICI Lombard's insurance lost three hundred and eighteen crore rupees in its audited accounts. Yet its profit after tax was nine hundred and forty six crore. How?
beats.cap: Can an insurer lose money on insurance, and still profit? From July to September 2026, ICICI Lombard's insurance lost ₹318 crore in its audited accounts. Yet its profit after tax was ₹946 crore (₹946.40 crore). How?

How?

beats.say: Picture a scale. On one side, what the insurance itself loses. On the other, what the insurer earns on money it holds while it waits to pay claims. Which side is heavier? And does every insurer have that second side?
